notes: The ATC PGM has occupied and unknown-valued cells but no ROS free-valued cells; non-occupied cells are candidates and trajectory support selects the analysis region.
CCTV coverage is an artificial evaluation mask, not a calibrated camera field of view.
Robot observations are scheduled sensing events, not planned paths.
Density is mean simultaneous pedestrian count divided by walkable zone area.
Display levels use the 50th and 85th percentiles of positive ATC density; continuous density remains authoritative and 0.5/1.5 persons per square meter are retained as absolute reference thresholds.
